title: RWB-S5-E3026: the cycle slice has no planned dependency row for its four consumed contracts or its Schedule library, and neither the plan nor the module model holds the re-appraisal record, the requirement id or the AC3 evidence
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json slices RWB-S5-E3026-APP, RWB-S5-E3026-CON and RWB-ITG-E3026-ITG (H, C, I, X and acs); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-026 (Acceptance criteria, Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Test cases); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 A1.4, A2.9.1 to A2.9.4.4 and Requirements served; Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIS-15, R-DIS-44 and R-DIS-06; _work/msr/context/S5.md (two tables, six REST operations, event EV-22, job JOB-19, workflow AssetDisposalWorkflow)
section: APP metadata row Depends on (build) and Contract dependencies; APP sections 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 11, 12.2, 12.6, 12.7, 13, 16 and 18; CON metadata rows; CON sections 2, 3, 7 AC3, AC6 and AC7, 11, 12.2, 12.6, 12.8 and 13
description: One combined row for both slices of the key. (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S5-E3026-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step needs the rwb-source-data appraisal read, the rwb-valuation valuation order, the rwb-case state read and move answer, and the workflow kit with its Schedule capability. (2) JOB-19 Re-appraisal monthly is the single job of the S5 ownership rows and this key is the service cycle story, yet the pattern set omits DP-10 and its library RWB-PLT-E1071-CON, so the Schedule has no plan row. (3) TSD S5 T-A.1 lists API-S5-003 POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations as Order or record a valuation, the Ownership Map ruling ASM-A6-api-6 gives that operation to rwb-valuation, and no target path is published, so the re-appraisal order is declared as a consumed row with the placeholder and SVAF is reached by that owner. (4) The legacy Data table names v_ace_valuation and v_ace_npa_asset, only rwb-source-data reads the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views, and the S5 row of Architecture v5 slide 13 names no call to P1. (5) The module model has no re-appraisal table and no appraisal_date, one_year_rule_applied or relist_count column, so the three rule inputs arrive on the owners facts and the cycle lives in the Schedule and in the durable workflow state. (6) The split plan carries no requirement id for either slice and the legacy master carries none, so both slices trace to REQ-S5-003 read from the FSD. (7) The plan assigns AC3 to RWB-ITG-E3026-ITG while the APP slice owns AC1, AC2 and AC4, and TC-E3-026-03 is that harness evidence.
evidence: split_plan.json slices of the key with H of three rows and empty C, I and X, and acs AC1, AC2 and AC4 on the APP slice and AC3 on the ITG slice; S5 ownership rows with two tables, six REST operations, one event EV-22, one job JOB-19 and one workflow; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-05, DP-09, DP-10, DP-13 and DP-19; Ownership Map ruling ASM-A6-api-6; TSD S5 T-A.1 row API-S5-003 and T5.1 row INT-11 SVAF; FSD S5 A2.9.3.1 (R-DIS-15, R-DIS-44, R-DIS-06, BR-S5-009) and Requirements served row REQ-S5-003; legacy RWB-E3-026 Data table rows v_ace_valuation, v_ace_npa_asset, recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row
area: Dependencies, scheduling and data ownership, S5 rwb-asset
proposed: Build against the published owner documents and their fakes on Day 1; name RWB-PLT-E1071-CON as the wave 0 library the Schedule needs without rewriting the H row; declare the valuation order as consumed from rwb-valuation with the placeholder; keep the three rule inputs as inputs of the decision record with no new column; trace both slices to REQ-S5-003; and leave the end-to-end evidence of AC3 with the wave 2 harness.

title: RWB-S5-E3026-CON: the published surface of the cycle has no source for its appraisal properties, its reason and route vocabulary, the order path or the JOB-19 parameters
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E3026-CON; Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 A2.9.3.1 and its document control and sign-off tables; Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIS-15 and R-DIS-44; Recovery Workbench TSD S5 v2 document control and sign-off table; _work/msr/context/S5.md (schema, base, topic, queue, six REST operations, job JOB-19)
section: CON sections 3, 7 AC1 to AC7, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.6, 12.8 and 13; APP sections 3, 11, 12.6 and 14
description: One combined row for the contract slice. (1) The appraisal reference, type, value and date exist only as the read-only ACE view fields DF-ACE-187 to DF-ACE-195 of v_ace_valuation, and the module model carries no appraisal column, so the Asset element additions are declared as an appraisal view of the consumed fact and not as columns of rwb_asset. (2) one_year_rule_applied and relist_count appear in the conditions of R-DIS-15 and R-DIS-44, and no list, no column and no field id is published for either, so the reason vocabulary and the rule inputs are declared as versioned inputs with the placeholder. (3) The target path of API-S5-003 and the operation and data-product names of the rwb-source-data read are not published. (4) The reference time and day of JOB-19 are not published. (5) The FSD S5 v3 and the TSD S5 v2 are In review with empty sign-off tables and this run has no approval step, so both stories stay in Draft.
evidence: TSD S5 T3.1 (asset and listing only, no appraisal, re-list-count or one-year-flag column), T3.2, T4 (R-DIS-15 and R-DIS-44 states and events), T-A.1 and T-A.2 (API-S5-003 purpose Order or record a valuation, no target path); FSD S5 A2.9.3.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIS-15 and R-DIS-44; S5 ownership rows with job JOB-19 and no published cadence time; FSD S5 and TSD S5 document control Status In review and empty document sign-off tables; AGENTS.md rules 9 and 10
area: Contract surface and governance, S5 rwb-asset
legacy_ref: RWB-E3-026 (Acceptance criteria AC1 and AC2, Data)
proposed: Declare the appraisal properties as a view of the owners fact and not as columns; publish the reason and route vocabulary from the package and the case owner; keep the three unpublished names and the Schedule reference time with the placeholder; and let the baseline review and step D1 fill them before the baseline is tagged, with both stories kept at Draft.
